title: Chapter 1
text: Readers love TJ K LUNE John & Jackie “ …this story is particularly poignant for me. It cuts very close to the bone, and it is told with painful realism. ” —Prism Book Alliance “ It is definitely worth reading if only to experience a true love affair. ” —MM Good Book Reviews “ This was such an emotional read, a tearing apart of your heart and pasting it back together kind of read… This is a story not to be missed. ” —The Novel Approach Into This River I Drown “ …this is another outstanding read by one of my favorite authors… It touched me deeply. ” —On Top Down Under Reviews Tell Me It’s Real “ It is real. The characters are real. The dialogue is real. And the actions are real. ” —Live Your Life, Buy the Book “ TJ Klune is awesome wrapped in crazy, regurgitated as spectacular… definitely in my fave books of 2013. I laughed, cried, I laughed while crying, and most of all I fell in love with all the characters. ” —Pants Off Reviews
